rules: JSON object member names are unique at every depth.
All externally supplied floating-point values are finite.
Public identifiers are exact signed 64-bit integers; timestamps are non-negative; neither accepts booleans or numeric strings.
Snapshot input is canonical base64 containing strict UTF-8 JSON and is validated before live mutation.
A nonzero snapshot ego references a ball contained in a full or rollback snapshot.
A cloaked ball is non-massive and retains its pre-cloak massive state.
Canonical Carbon binary tags use canonical padded base64 and reserved tags cannot mix with data keys.

Carbon batch identifiers increase monotonically within one runtime; an exact retry of the last accepted envelope is acknowledged without requeueing, while conflicting reuse of that identifier is rejected.
An ABI success envelope has status zero and exactly the fields ok and result.
Invalid setters, snapshot imports, and queued network envelopes have no partial side effects.
